feedback.worked_solution:
The general equation of a circle with radius $r$ centered at the origin is 

$$
{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}={r}^{2}.
$$

From the picture, we see that our circle is centered at $(0,0)$ and has radius $r=1.$ So, the equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={r}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & ={1}^{2} \\ {x}^{2}+{y}^{2} & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
